metrics.visualTitle: Mwh by time, DUID and year

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('calendar'[year], 'mstime'[time], 'duid'[DUID], "Mwh", 'calendar'[Mwh])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'calendar'[year], 'mstime'[time])

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'duid'[DUID])

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1 = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0PrimaryBase, 'mstime'[time])

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL1))

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0 = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0PrimaryBase, 'calendar'[year])

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL0))

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0SecondaryBase))

	VAR __DS0LimitBlock0DbCount = MIN(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count, 6)

	VAR __DS0LimitBlock1DbCount = 
		(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count * __DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count)

	VAR __DS0RemainingCapacityAtStart = DIVIDE(30000, __DS0LimitBlock0DbCount)

	VAR __DS0LimitBlock1Count = 
		CEILING(
			MAX(MIN(MIN(__DS0RemainingCapacityAtStart, 3500), __DS0LimitBlock1DbCount), 1),
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0InitTargetPrimaryCount = 
		IF(
			__DS0LimitBlock1DbCount <= __DS0LimitBlock1Count,
			__DS0LimitBlock1Count,
			IF(
				AND(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count > 1000, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count > 60),
				CEILING(DIVIDE(__DS0LimitBlock1Count, 60), 1),
				IF(
					__DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count > 60,
					__DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count,
					CEILING(DIVIDE(__DS0LimitBlock1Count, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count), 1)
				)
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0InitTargetSecondaryCount = 
		IF(
			__DS0LimitBlock1DbCount <= __DS0LimitBlock1Count,
			__DS0LimitBlock1Count,
			IF(
				AND(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count > 1000, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count > 60),
				60,
				IF(
					__DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count > 60,
					CEILING(DIVIDE(__DS0LimitBlock1Count, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count), 1),
					__DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count
				)
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0MinPrimaryCount = MIN(10, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count)

	VAR __DS0MinSecondaryCount = MIN(10, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count)

	VAR __DS0TargetPrimaryCount = 
		IF(
			__DS0InitTargetPrimaryCount < __DS0MinPrimaryCount,
			__DS0MinPrimaryCount,
			IF(
				__DS0InitTargetSecondaryCount < __DS0MinSecondaryCount,
				CEILING(DIVIDE(__DS0LimitBlock1Count, __DS0MinSecondaryCount), 1),
				__DS0InitTargetPrimaryCount
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0TargetSecondaryCount = 
		IF(
			__DS0InitTargetPrimaryCount < __DS0MinPrimaryCount,
			CEILING(DIVIDE(__DS0LimitBlock1Count, __DS0MinPrimaryCount), 1),
			IF(
				__DS0InitTargetSecondaryCount < __DS0MinSecondaryCount,
				__DS0MinSecondaryCount,
				__DS0InitTargetSecondaryCount
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0ScopedLimitL0 = 
		TOPN(6, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0, 'calendar'[year], 1)

	VAR __DS0ScopedLimitL1 = 
		SAMPLE(__DS0TargetPrimaryCount, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1, 'mstime'[time], 1)

	VAR __SyncDS0SyncTable = 
		SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
			ADDCOLUMNS(
				KEEPFILTERS(__DS0ScopedLimitL1),
				"Clonedtime", 'mstime'[time]
			),
			"SyncI0",
			SELECTCOLUMNS(
				KEEPFILTERS(__DS0ScopedLimitL1),
				"Clonedtime", 'mstime'[time]
			),
			[Clonedtime],
			ASC
		)

	VAR __DS0BodyRegroupedToDM1ScopedLimitedL1 = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__SyncDS0SyncTable,
			__DS0PrimaryBase
		)

	VAR __IsDM1Valid = 
		CALCULATE(NOT(ISEMPTY(__DS0BodyRegroupedToDM1ScopedLimitedL1)))

	VAR __DS0PrimaryLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0ScopedLimitL0,
			ADDCOLUMNS(
				KEEPFILTERS(__DS0BodyRegroupedToDM1ScopedLimitedL1),
				"IsDM1Valid", __IsDM1Valid
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0ScopedLimitL2 = 
		TOPN(__DS0TargetSecondaryCount, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'duid'[DUID], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryLimited,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0ScopedLimitL2,
				'duid'[DUID],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count", __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count,
		"DS0ScopedLimitL0Count", 6,
		"DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count", __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count,
		"DS0ScopedLimitL1Count", __DS0TargetPrimaryCount,
		"DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count", __DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count,
		"DS0ScopedLimitL2Count", __DS0TargetSecondaryCount
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0ScopedLimitL1

ORDER BY
	'mstime'[time]

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0Core,
		"Mintime", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'mstime'[time]),
		"Maxtime", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'mstime'[time]),
		"MinMwh", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Mwh]),
		"MaxMwh", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Mwh])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0ScopedLimitL2

ORDER BY
	'duid'[DUID]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'calendar'[year], 'mstime'[time], [ColumnIndex]

				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count", __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count,
		"DS0ScopedLimitL0Count", 6,
		"DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count", __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count,
		"DS0ScopedLimitL1Count", __DS0TargetPrimaryCount,
		"DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count", __DS0ScopedPreLimitL2Count,
		"DS0ScopedLimitL2Count", __DS0TargetSecondaryCount
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0ScopedLimitL1

ORDER BY
	'mstime'[time]

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0Core,
		"Mintime", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'mstime'[time]),
		"Maxtime", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'mstime'[time]),
		"MinMwh", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Mwh]),
		"MaxMwh", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Mwh])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0ScopedLimitL2

ORDER BY
	'duid'[DUID]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'calendar'[year], 'mstime'[time], [ColumnIndex]

metrics.visualTitle: Mw_ by time, year and month

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Natural gas"}, 'duid'[FuelSourceDescriptor])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'calendar'[year],
			'calendar'[month],
			'mstime'[time],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Mw_", 'calendar'[Mw_]
		)

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1 = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'mstime'[time])

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL1))

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0 = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'calendar'[year], 'calendar'[month])

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL0))

	VAR __DS0LimitBlock0DbCount = MIN(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count, 48)

	VAR __DS0RemainingCapacityAtStart = DIVIDE(30000, __DS0LimitBlock0DbCount)

	VAR __DS0LimitBlock1Count = 
		CEILING(
			MAX(MIN(MIN(__DS0RemainingCapacityAtStart, 3500), __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count), 1),
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0LimitBlock1LimitCount = CEILING(__DS0LimitBlock1Count, 1)

	VAR __DS0ScopedLimitL0 = 
		TOPN(48, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0, 'calendar'[year], 1, 'calendar'[month], 1)

	VAR __DS0ScopedLimitL1 = 
		SAMPLE(__DS0LimitBlock1LimitCount, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1, 'mstime'[time], 1)

	VAR __SyncDS0SyncTable = 
		SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
			ADDCOLUMNS(
				KEEPFILTERS(__DS0ScopedLimitL1),
				"Clonedtime", 'mstime'[time]
			),
			"SyncI0",
			SELECTCOLUMNS(
				KEEPFILTERS(__DS0ScopedLimitL1),
				"Clonedtime", 'mstime'[time]
			),
			[Clonedtime],
			ASC
		)

	VAR __DS0BodyRegroupedToDM1ScopedLimitedL1 = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__SyncDS0SyncTable,
			__DS0Core
		)

	VAR __IsDM1Valid = 
		CALCULATE(NOT(ISEMPTY(__DS0BodyRegroupedToDM1ScopedLimitedL1)))

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0ScopedLimitL0,
			ADDCOLUMNS(
				KEEPFILTERS(__DS0BodyRegroupedToDM1ScopedLimitedL1),
				"IsDM1Valid", __IsDM1Valid
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count", __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count,
		"DS0ScopedLimitL0Count", 48,
		"DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count", __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count,
		"DS0ScopedLimitL1Count", __DS0LimitBlock1LimitCount
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0ScopedLimitL1

ORDER BY
	'mstime'[time]

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0Core,
		"Mintime", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'mstime'[time]),
		"Maxtime", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'mstime'[time]),
		"MinMw_", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Mw_]),
		"MaxMw_", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Mw_])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'calendar'[year], 'calendar'[month], 'mstime'[time]

DEFINE
	VAR __SQDS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Natural gas"}, 'duid'[FuelSourceDescriptor])

	VAR __SQDS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('duid'[DUID], __SQDS0FilterTable, "Mwh", 'calendar'[Mwh])

	VAR __SQDS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(5, __SQDS0Core, [Mwh], 0)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(ROLLUPGROUP('duid'[DUID], 'duid'[State]), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"),
			__SQDS0BodyLimited,
			__SQDS0FilterTable,
			"record_count", 'calendar'[record_count],
			"Mwh", 'calendar'[Mwh]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(502, __DS0Core, [IsGrandTotalRowTotal], 0, 'duid'[DUID], 1, 'duid'[State], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC, 'duid'[DUID], 'duid'[State]
